description: This file defines the Java-friendly wrapper class 'JavaStreamingContext' for Spark Streaming's 'StreamingContext', providing methods to create and manage streaming data sources, including socket streams, file streams, queue streams, and custom receivers. It also includes utility functions for checkpointing, restoring from checkpoints, and context management, along with the companion object for context recreation and JAR retrieval.

classes.name: JavaStreamingContext
classes.description: A Java wrapper for Spark Streaming's StreamingContext, providing Java-friendly methods to create, manage, and control streaming data sources and context lifecycle.

methods.name: socketTextStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream that connects to a hostname and port, receiving UTF8 lines with specified storage level.

methods.name: socketStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from a socket, converting byte streams to objects using a provided converter function.

methods.name: textFileStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream that monitors a directory for new text files.

methods.name: binaryRecordsStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream that monitors a directory for new binary files with fixed record length.

methods.name: rawSocketStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from a socket that receives serialized blocks directly into the block manager.

methods.name: fileStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream by monitoring a directory for new files with specified key/value/input format classes.

methods.name: queueStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from a queue of RDDs, processing all or one RDD per batch.

methods.name: receiverStream
methods.description: Creates a DStream from a custom receiver implementation.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Creates a union of multiple DStreams of the same type.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Applies a transformation function on a list of DStreams to produce a new DStream.

methods.name: transformToPair
methods.description: Applies a transformation function on a list of DStreams to produce a new JavaPairDStream.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Sets the directory for periodic checkpointing of the streaming context.

methods.name: remember
methods.description: Configures DStreams to remember RDDs for a specified duration.

methods.name: addStreamingListener
methods.description: Adds a StreamingListener for system event notifications.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the streaming context.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the streaming context to terminate.

methods.name: awaitTerminationOrTimeout
methods.description: Waits for termination or a timeout, returning true if stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the streaming context, with options to stop SparkContext and to stop gracefully.
